name: Foundations & Arithmetic
blurb: Place value, divisibility, gcd, parity — the everybody-knows-this layer.

name: Number Theory
blurb: Congruences, Fermat/Euler, CRT, Legendre, LTE, reciprocity, Vieta jumping.

name: Algebra & Polynomials
blurb: Factoring, Vieta, symmetric functions, interpolation, roots of unity.

name: Inequalities
blurb: AM–GM, Cauchy–Schwarz, Engel, Jensen, rearrangement, SOS, smoothing.

name: Sequences, Series & Summation
blurb: Telescoping, perturbation, generating functions, recurrences, Abel summation.

name: Combinatorics
blurb: Counting principles, PIE, bijections, pigeonhole, Catalan, double counting.

name: Trigonometry & Complex Numbers
blurb: De Moivre, Euler's formula, roots of unity, Chebyshev polynomials.

name: Calculus & Analysis
blurb: Limits, derivatives, Taylor, MVT, Feynman integration, Riemann sums.

name: Meta-techniques & Heuristics
blurb: Small cases, invariants, extremal principle, induction, contradiction.

name: Geometry
blurb: Heron, coordinate & vector methods, power of a point, the shoelace formula.
